claim_boundary: This crosswalk does not promote a failed result, select a runtime parameter, or establish an independent validation claim. A new untouched holdout is required after any model change.

evidence: The Schefer line diagnostic preserves separate source/outlet boundaries but still fails the frozen timing and error screens.
Proust effective discharge coefficient varies by nominal diameter, so one global coefficient cannot reconcile all series.
PRESLHY performance varies strongly by nozzle diameter and pressure group.
findings.interpretation: The controlling boundary is likely a network of vessel, line, valve and terminal restriction rather than a single fixed aperture coefficient.
findings.next_evidence: Freeze measured line length/diameter, valve opening law, upstream pressure-temperature boundary and terminal geometry before reading outcomes.

evidence: A post-outcome 4 s source-valve sensitivity reduces Schefer 2006 outlet median APE to 19.83%, but does not establish a pass.
Schefer 2007 non-adiabatic wall sensitivity changes the pressure transient but leaves the joint screen failed.
findings.interpretation: Opening/closing dynamics and instrument boundary timing may explain the remaining transient mismatch, but the available traces cannot identify a production time constant.
findings.next_evidence: Obtain a new event with valve command, valve position or flow-meter timing on the same clock as vessel pressure.

evidence: PRESLHY's controlling frozen result is 0.500 (11/22); the later 0.727 rerun is post-outcome and demoted. The 1.0 mm group is 0/4 while 4.0 mm is 7/7 in the retained stratification.
Part-B non-adiabatic sensitivity remains 0.600; both 2 mm cases retain approximately 25.3% half-time error.
Proust reports diameter-dependent effective discharge coefficients.
findings.interpretation: A single choked-flow relation is insufficient across the observed diameter and pressure regimes; a declared regime transition or measured manifold loss is needed.
findings.next_evidence: Use an untouched campaign spanning at least two diameters and pressure regimes with measured upstream conditions and aperture/manifold geometry.

evidence: Dickens passes pressure screens but fails gas-temperature screens.
Adding consumed wall-thermal sensitivity to Schefer 2007 and PRESLHY Part-B does not close the joint screens.
findings.interpretation: Thermal state is a real limitation, but a generic wall heat-transfer coefficient alone is not sufficient; inlet and wall geometry/temperature history are under-specified.
findings.next_evidence: Freeze measured wall mass/heat capacity, inlet temperature history and geometry for a new independent charge or blowdown event.

model_change_order: Resolve apparatus boundary and line/valve inventory.
Declare diameter/regime semantics and thermal boundary inputs.
Freeze the revised model and protocol before inspecting outcomes.
Evaluate a new independent holdout and retain the current negative controls.
